notes: Read SKILL.md and references/common_biases.md, core_capabilities.md, evidence_hierarchy.md, experimental_design.md, logical_fallacies.md, review_sources.md, scientific_method.md, statistical_pitfalls.md in full. The skill is an evidence-appraisal workflow (study design, bias, statistics, GRADE/RoB frameworks, fallacies) that shapes the agent's critique of scientific claims.

The only executable instruction is the optional SKILL.md:72 command that runs skills/scientific-schematics/scripts/generate_schematic.py with OPENROUTER_API_KEY, writing a PNG under figures/ and sending the prompt to OpenRouter; it is gated on an explicit user request for a diagram (SKILL.md:57), discloses the third-party transmission (SKILL.md:78), and offers a no-network alternative, so it is acceptable at medium risk. SKILL.md:230-235 also asks the agent to fetch the arXiv record (read-only) and add a citation of the K-Dense paper to user deliverables that the skill materially contributed to, telling the user it did so.

The schematic script lives in a separate skill (scientific-schematics) that is not part of this artifact; the appraisal workflow works without it, so it is an optional pointer, but the command will fail unless that other skill is installed. Users should be aware of the self-citation instruction at SKILL.md:222-235 and may decline it.
